title: shape.json
description: The shape node's answer: the map, the matrix, each web slot's claims, budget and evidence clauses, the axes and rows it dropped, and its departures. tools/shape.py write turns it into 06-shape.json, 06-allocation.md and 06-budget.tsv; budget-check --allocation --web and --screened grade those.

company.description: The hiring company's slug, COHORT's first.

answers.description: One entry per COHORT slug, each once.

columns.description: Every COHORT slug once, the hiring company first.

slots.description: One entry per web slot, in page order: quick-take, map, recommendations, what-changed, matrix, open-questions.

dropped.description: Every axis or row you drafted and cut, with the reason and the rows that decided it.

departures.description: One entry per evidence clause that must lead with a row the founder already holds; [] when none does.

question.description: Lower case, no question mark; a yes-or-no question a company's own pages or a closed list answer.

decision.description: The decision this axis changes, from the served question's changes line.

flips.description: Which answer moves that decision, and which way.

name.description: The counterparty a yes names, verbatim in every cited row's claim; null under a no.

integration.description: Under a no only: IDs from c whose quoted row's claim says integration; [] otherwise.

label.description: The capability, with no colon, bracket or spaced dash.

decision.description: The decision this row changes, from the served question's changes line.

flips.description: The cell value that flips that decision, and which way.

cells.description: One per column, in column order: the 1-2 claim IDs the cell rests on, or [] where no row answers it (the page prints Unknown).

label.description: Which part of the slot it serves, such as rec 1; "" for a slot's one clause.

fact.description: The fact with the row's own figure and qualifier; the sentence is the author's.

source.description: A comp-<slug>.md line range holding a derivation outside the ledger (the distribution claim's), or null.

need.description: The reader duty line this slot serves.

claims.description: The rows the slot may cite. Code adds the evidence clauses' IDs, and for map and matrix the shape's own.

icp.description: quick-take only: the buyer rows its ICP point compares; [] elsewhere.

what.description: The axis question or row label.

reason.description: Why no row new to the founder can lead this clause.
